description: Named the cold flags, the short loaf, the sixpence, and the latch.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Spoke for the back aisle and the loom, and went in to eat.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Left by the south door from three rows ahead, and did not turn or speak.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Set the second turning and the fourteenth head, and would not have them shouted in the porch.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Answered for the fourteenthly, the tomb, and the sneeze, and said he was not ill.
name: William Shakespeare
